survivors.where: upper left rock wall and upper building roof
survivors.desc: A pitch-black shadow completely obscures the cliff face and structures underneath, concealing geometry and potential paths.

verify.why: A completely black, unlit shadow casts across the upper-left area, entirely hiding terrain details and building geometry.

survivors.where: center broken wooden bridge and ramp structure
survivors.desc: The middle section of the wooden walkway collapses into fragmented, overlapping planks, making it visually ambiguous whether the route is walkable or impassable visual noise.

verify.why: The fractured planks on the central ramp create a chaotic mesh where it is impossible to tell if the path is walkable or blocked.

survivors.where: top of the long ladder on the right
survivors.desc: The ladder extends upwards and clips directly into the solid underside of the wooden bridge deck with no opening for a player to climb through.

verify.why: The top of the wooden ladder leads directly into the solid floorboards of the bridge platform above without any opening.

survivors.desc: The chaotic overlap of broken wooden planks makes it ambiguous whether this is a walkable slope or impassable visual debris.

verify.why: The middle section of the walkway features a disorderly pile of broken planks that obscures the navigable path.

survivors.desc: An extremely dark pitch-black shadow completely obscures the cliff geometry and hut structure, hiding potential pathways.

survivors.where: cone tree on upper cliff wall
survivors.desc: A conical tree model sticks directly out of a steep vertical rock wall without visible support or roots.

verify.why: A yellow conical tree model protrudes horizontally straight out of a vertical cliff wall with no visible roots or ledge.

survivors.where: upper-left cliff and building under dark shadow
survivors.desc: A harsh, completely black shadow conceals the terrain and building geometry beneath the upper cliff, making depth and pathing unreadable.

verify.why: Harsh, un-shadow-mapped pitch-black geometry in the upper-left hides structural details and potential walkways.

survivors.where: yellow cone prop on the left cliff wall
survivors.desc: The stylized tree or cone prop is attached horizontally to a vertical cliff face without any supporting ledge or surface.

verify.why: The stylized yellow tree model on the upper-left cliff wall is placed floating sideways out of the vertical rock face.

survivors.where: collapsed ramp structure in the center
survivors.desc: Wooden planks and support beams intersect and clip haphazardly into each other without structural joins.

verify.why: Planks and beams in the collapsed ramp section clip aggressively through one another without believable physical joints.

survivors.where: central wooden platform and walkway network
survivors.desc: The dense layering of wooden platforms, roofs, and stilts without clear visual distinction makes it difficult to discern walkable paths from roofs.

verify.why: The dense layering of identical wooden materials across rooftops, platforms, and stilts makes it difficult to distinguish walkable paths from non-traversable roofs.

survivors.where: dark cave opening at the upper left wall
survivors.desc: The cave entrance is a flat pitch-black polygon without ambient lighting or geometry falloff, breaking environment realism.

verify.why: The cave entrance is rendered as a flat, pitch-black silhouette lacking internal geometry or light falloff.

survivors.where: upper right boardwalk fence posts and roof intersection
survivors.desc: Wooden fence posts and support beams clip directly through the sloped roof surfaces below.

verify.why: Vertical support posts and railings pass directly through the sloped green roof panels without proper structural mounting or cutouts.

survivors.desc: Uniform brown wood materials across roofs, walkways, railings, and support pillars create high visual noise, making walkable paths visually indistinguishable from roofs.

verify.why: Uniform brown wood textures used across rooftops, railings, and walkways create high visual noise and obscure playable paths.

survivors.where: layered wooden stairs along the middle-left cliff face
survivors.desc: Multiple overlapping stairs, ramps, and roof edges share identical colors and silhouettes, making the climbing route up the cliff face visually confusing.

verify.why: Overlapping stairs, ramps, and roof edges along the cliff face use identical materials and silhouettes, creating a visually confusing climbing route.

survivors.where: central complex of layered boardwalks and rooftops
survivors.desc: Multiple overlapping layers of dark wooden boardwalks, roofs, and stilts blend together, making it difficult to distinguish walkable paths from non-traversable architecture.

verify.why: Multiple overlapping layers of dark wooden structures blend together, making it hard to identify traversable boardwalks.

survivors.where: dark cave opening on the top-left cliffside
survivors.desc: The cave entrance is a completely flat, pitch-black void without depth or lighting falloff, making it ambiguous whether it is an accessible tunnel or background art.

verify.why: The cave opening appears as a flat, unlit black void without visual depth, leaving its function as a tunnel unclear.

refuted.where: cavern entrance along the top-left cliff

verify.why: The cavern entrance sits against sunlit cliff walls rather than blending into cliff shadows, making it stand out as a stark black shape.
